name: QuickBooks Online
one_liner: The leading small business accounting software. Track income, expenses, and run payroll from $30/month.
short_description: QuickBooks Online is the most widely used accounting software for small businesses, including private practices. It handles invoicing, expense tracking, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.
long_description: QuickBooks Online is Intuit's cloud-based accounting platform used by millions of small businesses. For mental health practices, it provides invoicing, expense categorization, bank feed connections, profit & loss statements, and tax preparation support. The platform integrates with many practice management systems to sync payment data. QuickBooks also offers payroll add-ons for practices with employees. Most solo practitioners use Simple Start ($30/month), while group practices typically need Plus ($90/month) for time tracking and project profitability.

pricing.notes: Prices shown are standard rates. Frequent promotions offer 50% off for first 3 months.

compliance.notes: QuickBooks is not HIPAA compliant and does not sign BAAs. Use for financial data only, not clinical/PHI.
